entities.name: Gahiji
entities.description: Legendary beast from an unknown plane revered as a god by the Rahode tribe.

entities.name: Battle of Flat Sky
entities.description: Battle in which Gahiji saved the slaughtered Rahode.

events.summary: At the Battle of Flat Sky, Gahiji charged into the Rahode's foes and saved the tribe.
events.quote: He saved the tribe, and now Gahiji dwells with them in a place of honor

relations.note: They revere him as a god.
relations.quote: Gahiji is revered as a god by the fierce Rahode tribe
